slides.headline: THE MAN WHO RAN FOR PRESIDENT TWICE TO PROTECT WORKERS JUST FILED A BILL MAKING YOUR AI JOB A 20-YEAR FELONY
slides.image_prompt: Bernie Sanders, waist-up, fierce conviction, eyes direct to camera, gripping a thick official government bill document raised chest-high in both hands toward the viewer. U.S. Senate chamber behind him — mahogany desks in a wide arc, American flags flanking the raised rostrum — all flooded with vivid deep orange and amber light. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, natural skin texture, slight film grain. Accent: deep burnt orange against warm amber gold.

slides.headline: EVERY AI LAB IN AMERICA WOKE UP THIS WEEK ONE BILL AWAY FROM A FEDERAL FELONY
slides.body: Building smarter AI was a race. Maybe someday regulated, maybe slowed. Nobody put 'federal prison' in the risk column. Then a bill dropped in the US Senate on September 3

slides.headline: HE CLOCKED IN AT 9AM. THE BILL WAS ALREADY FILED
slides.body: By the time you sat down at your desk, a sitting US senator had already filed a bill prescribing 20 years in federal prison for exactly the work you're doing.

slides.headline: SAME PENALTY AS NUCLEAR WEAPONS
slides.body: Longer than many armed robbery sentences, and it targets individual engineers

slides.headline: THE MAN BEHIND THE BILL SPENT 40 YEARS FIGHTING CORPORATIONS
slides.body: Bernie Sanders is 84 years old. He built his career fighting corporate power: taxing the rich, protecting workers, taking on Wall Street. Now he's threatening to put you in federal prison.

slides.headline: EVERY AI LAB NOW FACES A LINE THEY CAN'T SEE
slides.body: OpenAI. Google. Anthropic. Every team on the frontier now has to ask whether your next model release crosses into a federal felony. Nobody knows exactly where that line is.

slides.headline: YOUR AI STACK JUST BECAME A LEGAL QUESTION
slides.body:
If this bill advances, every US business running AI tools near human-level performance faces exposure, not just labs, but companies using it.

Knowing what's in your AI stack is no longer optional.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: BERNIE SANDERS MADE BUILDING SMARTER AI A 20-YEAR FELONY
slides.body: Sanders filed a permanent ban on smarter-than-human AI 20 years in federal prison for violators Same penalty as nuclear weapons Filed September 3, 2026 Send this to a friend in tech

caption:
A US senator just introduced a bill that makes building smarter-than-human AI punishable by 20 years in federal prison. Swipe through the details. 🚨

Bernie Sanders' bill to permanently ban AI that exceeds human intelligence, the 20-year prison sentence for violators, how that compares to armed robbery sentences, Sanders' decades as a worker protector now turned against individual engineers, the scene of AI engineers clocking in Monday morning unaware their work became a potential federal felony, what it means for every major AI lab's product roadmap, and what businesses running AI tools need to understand now

For the first time, a sitting US senator is treating AI development as a criminal act on par with nuclear weapons. The political window for unchecked AI development is closing faster than Silicon Valley expected.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this means for your tools.

Sources: Watcher.Guru
